name: remotion-skill-examples
description: Four finished compositions built with the remotion-motion-graphics skill

scripts.render:profile: remotion render src/index.ts HaidrrrryPromo out/profile-promo.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16
scripts.render:focuscat: remotion render src/index.ts FocusCatPromo out/focus-cat-promo.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16
scripts.render:selffix: remotion render src/index.ts SelfFix out/self-fix.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16
scripts.render:lyrics: remotion render src/lyrics/index.ts SolitudeLyrics out/solitude-lyrics.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16 --gl=angle
scripts.render:codeedit: remotion render src/index.ts CodeEdit out/code-edit.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16
scripts.render:squirrel: remotion render src/squirrel/index.ts SquirrelBurger out/squirrel-burger.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 17
scripts.render:squirrel-long: remotion render src/squirrel/index.ts SquirrelBurgerLong out/squirrel-burger-long.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18
scripts.render:squirrel-long-ar: remotion render src/squirrel/index.ts SquirrelBurgerLongAR out/squirrel-burger-long-ar.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18
scripts.render:veilllm: remotion render src/veilllm/index.ts VeilLLMShortAR out/veilllm-short-ar.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18
scripts.render:orbit3d: remotion render src/three3d/index.ts Orbit3D out/orbit-3d.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16 --gl=angle
scripts.render:claudedance: remotion render src/claudedance/index.ts ClaudeDance out/claude-dance.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16 --gl=angle
scripts.render:feelit: remotion render src/claudedance/index.ts ClawdFeelIt out/clawd-feel-it.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 17 --gl=angle
scripts.encode:clawdedit: ffmpeg -y -framerate 30 -i out/clawdedit/frames/element-%03d.png -i public/clawdedit/sound.wav -vf vignette=angle=PI/6 -c:v libx264 -profile:v high -crf 17 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 320k -movflags +faststart -shortest out/clawd-edit.mp4
